agent.problem: The earlier cards establish that there is an inheritance, but they give no context from which the baker can reason that it is reserved in heaven rather than Jerusalem or Canaan. As a fill-in-the-blank question, this tests unseen wording by luck rather than meaning the baker can reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
